scope_note: Derived ONLY from telegram-llm-bot repos ['AstrBot', 'ChatGPT-Telegram-Bot', 'LangBot', 'nekro-agent']. Categories are app-type-relative — this checklist does NOT transfer to other app types.

required.aliases: error message improvement / error handling / async error handling
required.day1_tell: Trigger a known sync and async failure path; confirm the user-facing error includes the operation, cause, and recovery hint without leaking stack traces.

required.aliases: timeout error handling / timeout adjustment / session timeout handling
required.day1_tell: Run a request against an endpoint that sleeps past the configured timeout; confirm it aborts at the expected time and reports a timeout-specific error.

required.aliases: localization updates / localization display fix / language localization support
required.day1_tell: Switch UI/API locale to a non-default language; confirm translated labels, errors, and formatted dates/numbers render correctly.

required.aliases: empty value handling / empty input validation / null usage handling
required.day1_tell: Submit empty string, whitespace-only input, and explicit null for the field; confirm validation rejects or handles each without crashing.

required.aliases: dependency fix / missing dependency fix / dependency removal
required.day1_tell: Install from a clean lockfile/cache and start the app; confirm no missing, unused, or incompatible dependency errors appear.

required.aliases: provider integration / provider compatibility fix / provider api compatibility
required.day1_tell: Call the integrated provider with a minimal valid request; confirm authentication, request shape, and response parsing work against the live or mocked provider API.

required.aliases: environment configuration / default configuration / default configuration update
required.day1_tell: Start with no user config present; confirm documented defaults are loaded and visible in effective configuration.

required.aliases: api compatibility fix / api format compatibility / api response compatibility
required.day1_tell: Feed the client both old and new API response formats; confirm both are parsed or the unsupported one fails with a clear compatibility error.

required.aliases: file message support / message formatting fix / document message support
required.day1_tell: Send a message containing an attached text/document file; confirm it is accepted, formatted, and displayed as a file message.

required.aliases: failure notification fix / message parsing normalization / message sending
required.day1_tell: Force message delivery to fail; confirm a failure notification is emitted and the failed message is parsed and displayed consistently.

required.aliases: proxy support / proxy dependency support / proxy support bundling
required.day1_tell: Run traffic through an HTTP/SOCKS proxy; confirm outbound requests use the proxy and still succeed.

required.aliases: type usage fix / type correctness fix / type checking fix
required.day1_tell: Run static type checking on a clean checkout; confirm no type errors are reported in the changed area.

required.aliases: message merging fix / message segmentation merge / message segmentation
required.day1_tell: Send a long message that is split into segments; confirm the segments are merged back in order without duplication or loss.

required.aliases: module import fix / import warning fix / missing import fix
required.day1_tell: Start the app from a clean environment; confirm all modules import without missing-import errors or import warnings.

required.aliases: empty response handling / null reply handling / null response handling
required.day1_tell: Mock a provider returning an empty body/null reply; confirm the app shows a controlled empty-response error instead of crashing.

required.aliases: permission management / command permission hardening / command permission configuration
required.day1_tell: Attempt a privileged command as an unprivileged user; confirm it is denied and logged without executing.

required.aliases: schema conversion fix / schema compatibility fix / schema requirement fix
required.day1_tell: Validate a converted schema against the target schema validator; confirm required fields and compatibility rules pass.

required.aliases: deployment scripting / deployment script enhancement / deployment script fix
required.day1_tell: Run the deployment script on a fresh environment with dry-run or staging settings; confirm it completes idempotently.

required.aliases: identifier parsing fix / identifier correction / identifier retrieval fix
required.day1_tell: Provide identifiers with prefixes, suffixes, and invalid characters; confirm parsing extracts the correct ID or rejects clearly.

required.aliases: lazy dependency loading / deferred dependency loading / dynamic dependency loading
required.day1_tell: Start the app without the optional dependency installed; confirm it starts and only loads/errors when the related feature is invoked.

required.aliases: pagination size change / pagination parameter fix / responsive pagination
required.day1_tell: Request page sizes below, at, and above the limit; confirm pagination parameters produce correct item counts and navigation metadata.

required.aliases: adapter integration / adapter configuration / adapter implementation
required.day1_tell: Enable the adapter with minimal config; confirm initialization, request forwarding, and teardown all succeed.

required.aliases: status indicator fix / status reporting / status display correction
required.day1_tell: Force each status state: idle, running, failed, complete; confirm the displayed indicator matches the underlying state.

required.aliases: plugin invocation fix / plugin installation fix / plugin execution fix
required.day1_tell: Install and invoke a simple test plugin; confirm installation, execution, output capture, and error reporting work.

required.aliases: layout display fix / layout spacing fix / responsive layout fixes
required.day1_tell: Resize the viewport across desktop/tablet/mobile widths; confirm spacing and layout do not overlap or clip.

required.aliases: markdown rendering control / markdown rendering support / markdown error rendering
required.day1_tell: Render markdown containing code, links, tables, and malformed syntax; confirm it displays safely and predictably.

required.aliases: search provider integration / web search integration / search integration
required.day1_tell: Issue a query requiring web search; confirm the configured search provider is called and results are included or cited.

required.aliases: hot reload fix / development hot reload / configuration hot reload
required.day1_tell: Change a watched config/source file during development; confirm hot reload applies the change without full restart or stale state.

required.aliases: url parsing fix / url extraction fix / url parameter parsing
required.day1_tell: Parse URLs with encoded params, fragments, empty params, and repeated keys; confirm extracted values are correct.

required.aliases: api configuration / dynamic api configuration / api configuration fix
required.day1_tell: Change API base URL/key/model at runtime or via config; confirm subsequent requests use the new settings.

required.aliases: command system refactor / command configuration change / command settings refactor
required.day1_tell: Run existing commands with old and new settings formats; confirm routing and behavior remain correct or migrate cleanly.

required.aliases: context compression / context compression fallback / context propagation
required.day1_tell: Send a conversation exceeding context limits; confirm compression occurs and essential context is preserved or fallback is used.

required.aliases: default model update / default model presets / default model change
required.day1_tell: Start with no model selected; confirm the documented default model/preset is selected and usable.

required.aliases: empty prompt handling / prompt behavior / prompt management
required.day1_tell: Submit an empty prompt; confirm the system blocks it or applies the defined empty-prompt behavior without sending junk.

required.aliases: plugin lifecycle cleanup / plugin data cleanup / plugin lifecycle management
required.day1_tell: Install, enable, disable, and uninstall a plugin; confirm lifecycle hooks run and plugin data is cleaned or retained as specified.

required.aliases: file format support / document format support
required.day1_tell: Upload each supported document format plus an unsupported one; confirm supported files parse and unsupported files fail clearly.

required.aliases: argument handling fix / argument handling / argument key handling
required.day1_tell: Invoke the command with missing, extra, and differently cased arguments; confirm argument handling matches the spec.

required.aliases: authentication error messaging / authentication error handling
required.day1_tell: Use invalid, expired, and missing credentials; confirm authentication errors are specific and actionable.

required.aliases: path validation / install path validation / path safety validation
required.day1_tell: Enter absolute, relative, symlink, and traversal install paths; confirm unsafe paths are rejected.

required.aliases: native upload handling / file upload handling / upload filename handling
required.day1_tell: Upload files with Unicode, spaces, duplicate names, and long filenames; confirm native upload preserves safe filenames.

required.aliases: internationalization support / internationalization enhancement
required.day1_tell: Switch the application language and reload; confirm UI strings, messages, and formatting remain localized.

required.aliases: missing configuration warning / configuration warning fallback / configuration error messaging
required.day1_tell: Start with a required config key missing; confirm a clear warning/error names the key and fallback behavior.

required.aliases: sandbox support / sandbox feature work / workspace sandbox features
required.day1_tell: Run a workspace operation inside the sandbox; confirm file/process/network access is restricted to allowed scope.

required.aliases: download type handling / file download handling / file download routing
required.day1_tell: Download file types such as image, text, PDF, and unknown binary; confirm each routes to the correct handler.

required.aliases: path traversal prevention
required.day1_tell: Request a file path containing '../' and encoded traversal sequences; confirm access is blocked.

required.aliases: payload compatibility / payload compatibility fix
required.day1_tell: Send legacy and current payload shapes to the handler; confirm compatible payloads are accepted and normalized.

required.aliases: configuration reset / configuration reset command / configuration reset fix
required.day1_tell: Run the configuration reset command; confirm user settings return to defaults and stale values are removed.

required.aliases: schema validation compliance / schema validation models / schema validation
required.day1_tell: Validate good and bad payloads against the schema; confirm invalid data is rejected with field-level errors.

required.aliases: streaming persistence optimization / streaming rate reduction / streaming performance optimization
required.day1_tell: Stream a long response; confirm UI/storage updates are throttled and final content is complete.

required.aliases: mobile layout adjustment / mobile layout adaptation / mobile ui adaptation
required.day1_tell: Open the UI on a narrow mobile viewport; confirm controls remain usable without horizontal scrolling.

required.aliases: plugin identifier validation / identifier format validation / identifier validation compatibility
required.day1_tell: Create plugin IDs with uppercase, spaces, slashes, and valid characters; confirm validation accepts only allowed formats.

required.aliases: cross-platform file reading / file input support / file reading support
required.day1_tell: Read the same test file on Windows, macOS, and Linux paths/encodings; confirm content is identical.

required.aliases: configuration persistence / plugin configuration persistence
required.day1_tell: Change plugin configuration, restart the app, and reopen it; confirm the setting persists.

required.aliases: database migration integration / database migration compatibility / database migration packaging
required.day1_tell: Start with an old database schema; confirm migrations run once and the app can read/write afterward.

required.aliases: message routing / message routing rule / message role routing
required.day1_tell: Send messages for each role/channel; confirm routing rules deliver them to the intended destination only.

required.aliases: performance optimization / system optimization
required.day1_tell: Run the baseline workload and compare latency/memory/CPU to the target threshold; confirm no regression.

required.aliases: mention parsing fix / mention parsing / mention parsing optimization
required.day1_tell: Send text with @mentions, emails, and code blocks; confirm only valid mentions are parsed.

required.aliases: credential configuration / credential format validation / credential validation
required.day1_tell: Enter credentials with extra spaces, missing fields, and wrong formats; confirm normalization and validation behavior.

required.aliases: streaming response latency / stream response compatibility / streaming response handling
required.day1_tell: Stream a response from a compatible provider; confirm first token latency and chunk parsing meet expectations.

required.aliases: user access blocking / blocked user handling / user blocking
required.day1_tell: Attempt access as a blocked user; confirm all actions are denied and the block reason is surfaced.

required.aliases: history clearing fix / history retention configuration / history retention fix
required.day1_tell: Clear history and restart; confirm deleted entries stay deleted and retention settings are respected.

required.aliases: navigation entries / navigation links
required.day1_tell: Open the navigation menu; confirm every new entry links to an existing route and highlights correctly.

required.aliases: task interface / task handling integration
required.day1_tell: Create, update, complete, and fail a task through the interface; confirm state transitions are reflected.

required.aliases: parameter compatibility / parameter type support
required.day1_tell: Pass parameters as string, number, boolean, array, and null where supported; confirm type handling matches spec.

required.aliases: message serialization fix / response serialization fix
required.day1_tell: Serialize and deserialize a message/response containing Unicode, attachments, and metadata; confirm round-trip equality.

required.aliases: dynamic model discovery / model discovery support
required.day1_tell: Call model discovery against the provider; confirm available models are listed and selectable.

required.aliases: configuration template optimization / configuration loading optimization
required.day1_tell: Load configuration from template, env, and user file; confirm loading is fast and produces expected effective config.

required.aliases: recording behavior fix / feedback recording fix
required.day1_tell: Submit positive and negative feedback once each; confirm exactly one record per action is stored.

required.aliases: capability indicator display / capability display indicators
required.day1_tell: Toggle capabilities on a model/provider; confirm capability indicators update accurately.

required.aliases: duplicate display fix
required.day1_tell: Render a list containing duplicate IDs/names; confirm each item appears only when intended.

required.aliases: filename sanitization / name sanitization
required.day1_tell: Upload/create names containing slashes, control chars, emoji, and reserved words; confirm sanitized safe filenames.

required.aliases: fallback request routing / route fallback fix
required.day1_tell: Request an unknown route; confirm fallback routing serves the intended page or 404 without breaking assets.

required.aliases: invalid parameter removal / parameter removal
required.day1_tell: Send a payload containing deprecated/invalid parameters; confirm they are removed before provider/API submission.

required.aliases: platform compatibility fix / platform compatibility
required.day1_tell: Run the feature on each supported OS/runtime version; confirm behavior is consistent.

required.aliases: embedding provider support / embedding provider integration
required.day1_tell: Generate embeddings with the configured provider; confirm vector dimensions and metadata match expectations.

required.aliases: plugin update tracking / plugin update detection
required.day1_tell: Publish/mock a newer plugin version; confirm update detection marks the plugin and does not flag current versions.

required.aliases: state reset fix
required.day1_tell: Trigger the reset action; confirm all intended state is cleared and unrelated state remains intact.

required.aliases: background command execution / background handler execution
required.day1_tell: Start a background command and continue using the UI; confirm it runs asynchronously and reports completion.

required.aliases: input composition handling / composition input handling
required.day1_tell: Type using an IME composition flow; confirm Enter does not submit until composition ends.

required.aliases: configuration interface improvement / configuration interface
required.day1_tell: Open and edit configuration through the UI; confirm validation, save, and reload work.

required.aliases: clipboard utility fix / clipboard compatibility fix
required.day1_tell: Copy text containing Unicode and newlines to/from clipboard; confirm clipboard operations succeed on supported platforms.

required.aliases: upload error handling
required.day1_tell: Force upload network failure and unsupported file type; confirm upload errors are clear and recoverable.

required.aliases: module path alignment / module path fix
required.day1_tell: Import modules using configured aliases/paths; confirm runtime and build tools resolve the same paths.

required.aliases: transition layout stability / layout stability
required.day1_tell: Trigger panel/page transitions rapidly; confirm layout dimensions remain stable with no jumps.

required.aliases: audio input support / voice input support
required.day1_tell: Record or upload a short audio input; confirm it is captured, processed, and attached/transcribed as expected.

required.aliases: environment variable propagation / environment setting propagation
required.day1_tell: Set an environment variable before launching child tasks/services; confirm the child process receives it.

required.aliases: response content filtering / response filtering
required.day1_tell: Return content containing blocked terms or unsafe markup; confirm response filtering removes or flags it.

required.aliases: dependency addition
required.day1_tell: Install from scratch; confirm the newly added dependency is present in manifest and lockfile and loads correctly.

required.aliases: empty response retry
required.day1_tell: Mock an empty provider response followed by a valid response; confirm retry occurs and final response is used.

required.aliases: url suffix handling / url suffix correction
required.day1_tell: Parse URLs with trailing slashes, suffixes, and query strings; confirm suffix handling is correct.

required.aliases: tool invocation fix
required.day1_tell: Invoke a tool with valid arguments; confirm call, result handling, and error handling work end to end.

required.aliases: empty-state shortcut / empty state action
required.day1_tell: Open an empty-state screen and click its shortcut action; confirm it navigates or creates the expected item.

required.aliases: frontend asset optimization / frontend optimization
required.day1_tell: Build frontend assets and inspect bundle size/loading; confirm optimization reduces or meets target size.

required.aliases: ui component simplification / component simplification
required.day1_tell: Render the simplified component with default and edge props; confirm behavior matches the old component.

required.aliases: password authentication fix / authentication configuration fix
required.day1_tell: Login with correct, wrong, and missing password configuration; confirm authentication behavior matches config.

required.aliases: configuration override support / configuration override fix
required.day1_tell: Set the same option in default config, env, and override file; confirm the override value wins.

required.aliases: media handling fix / media delivery fix
required.day1_tell: Send media content through the delivery path; confirm it arrives with correct MIME type and preview/download behavior.

required.aliases: timestamp parsing fix
required.day1_tell: Parse timestamps with timezone, milliseconds, and invalid values; confirm correct dates or clear errors.

required.aliases: configuration precedence
required.day1_tell: Define conflicting config values across sources; confirm precedence order matches documentation.

required.aliases: configuration type coercion / configuration type handling
required.day1_tell: Provide config values as strings for booleans/numbers/lists; confirm coercion or rejection is correct.

required.aliases: undefined value handling / undefined value fix
required.day1_tell: Pass undefined/missing fields through the handler; confirm defaults or validation prevent crashes.

required.aliases: emoji support / emoji response handling
required.day1_tell: Send and receive emoji, skin tones, and surrogate pairs; confirm they render and serialize correctly.

required.aliases: reply routing / reply routing fix
required.day1_tell: Reply in a thread/channel/private context; confirm the reply routes to the original context.

required.aliases: query telemetry / service telemetry
required.day1_tell: Execute a query with telemetry enabled and disabled; confirm metrics are emitted only when allowed.

required.aliases: service configuration migration / configuration auto migration
required.day1_tell: Start with an old service config; confirm automatic migration updates it and preserves values.

required.aliases: instance identifier management / instance identifier retrieval
required.day1_tell: Start two app instances; confirm each has a stable unique instance identifier.

required.aliases: file audio support / audio file support
required.day1_tell: Upload WAV/MP3/M4A files; confirm supported audio files are accepted and processed.

required.aliases: streaming mode toggle / streaming mode fix
required.day1_tell: Toggle streaming mode on and off; confirm requests use streaming only when enabled.

required.aliases: api integration update / api integration
required.day1_tell: Call the updated API integration with a sample request; confirm request/response mapping matches the new API.

required.aliases: message handling refactor / message flow refactor
required.day1_tell: Send normal, edited, failed, and retried messages; confirm the refactored flow preserves behavior.

required.aliases: log level adjustment
required.day1_tell: Set log level to debug/info/warn/error; confirm only appropriate messages are emitted.

required.aliases: image generation compatibility / image compatibility
required.day1_tell: Send generated/received images through the target provider/client; confirm compatible image formats work.

required.aliases: startup configuration fix / startup entry fix
required.day1_tell: Start the app with minimal startup config; confirm startup entries load in the correct order.

required.aliases: role message merging / message role fix
required.day1_tell: Send adjacent messages with different roles; confirm role boundaries are preserved when merging.

required.aliases: task cancellation scoping / task cancellation
required.day1_tell: Cancel one running task among multiple tasks; confirm only the targeted task is cancelled.

required.aliases: versioning / changelog / release notes / semver
required.day1_tell: Build a release artifact; confirm version, changelog, and semver tag are consistent.

required.aliases: cache / caching layer / cache invalidation
required.day1_tell: Read, update, and invalidate a cached value; confirm stale data is not served after invalidation.

optional.aliases: prompt reset isolation / prompt reset handling / prompt state isolation
optional.day1_tell: Reset the prompt in one conversation/session; confirm other conversations retain their prompt state.
Run the translation coverage check; confirm every referenced translation key exists in all supported locales.

optional.aliases: log display improvement / log display cleanup / log display optimization
optional.day1_tell: Generate multiline logs with ANSI/control characters; confirm the log viewer displays clean, readable entries.

optional.aliases: usage metric correction / usage metric extraction / usage metric handling
optional.day1_tell: Send a request with known token/usage metadata; confirm recorded usage matches the provider response.

optional.aliases: polling failure recovery / polling retry handling / polling loop recovery
optional.day1_tell: Make the polling endpoint fail twice then recover; confirm retries/backoff occur and the loop resumes.

optional.aliases: websocket messaging / websocket client / websocket delivery fix
optional.day1_tell: Send a websocket message while connected, disconnected, and reconnecting; confirm delivery or retry behavior is correct.

optional.aliases: code block segmentation / semantic code segmentation
optional.day1_tell: Segment a file containing multiple functions/classes and code fences; confirm chunks preserve semantic boundaries.

optional.aliases: image upload support / image upload fix
optional.day1_tell: Upload PNG, JPEG, oversized, and invalid image files; confirm valid images work and invalid ones fail clearly.
Send a request with the documented wire format; confirm the server accepts it and rejects malformed variants.
Send messages just inside and just outside the batching window; confirm batches flush at the configured timeout.

optional.aliases: test reliability fix / test failure fix
optional.day1_tell: Run the affected test 20 times with randomized order; confirm it passes consistently.
Build the container from a clean Docker cache; confirm image builds and starts successfully.
Start in development mode with dev database settings; confirm it connects to the dev database only.
Run an operation that creates temp files/resources, then cancel it; confirm all resources are cleaned up.

optional.aliases: command suggestion support / command suggestion feature
optional.day1_tell: Type a command prefix; confirm relevant command suggestions appear and can be selected.

optional.aliases: rendering issue fix / ui rendering fixes
optional.day1_tell: Open the affected UI state in supported browsers; confirm no visual glitches, clipping, or console render errors.
Render text containing characters missing from the primary font; confirm fallback font displays them legibly.

optional.aliases: qr registration flow / qr configuration flow
optional.day1_tell: Complete the QR registration/configuration flow from scan to confirmation; confirm the account/config is saved.
Start with valid and invalid config files; confirm validation catches bad values before runtime use.

optional.aliases: blank input guard / empty input guard
optional.day1_tell: Submit blank or whitespace-only input; confirm the action is blocked with no backend request.
Change a user preference, reload, and log back in; confirm the preference persists.
Send messages with added, removed, and failed attachments; confirm attachment events update message state correctly.

optional.aliases: usage statistics command / usage statistics dashboard
optional.day1_tell: Run the usage statistics command/dashboard; confirm totals match known seeded usage data.
Resolve the same path before and after moving the target; confirm cache invalidates or updates correctly.
Render code blocks in multiple languages; confirm syntax highlighting is applied and does not corrupt text.
Process a batch containing empty messages; confirm empty entries are filtered before send/display.

optional.aliases: display readability styling / code readability styling
optional.day1_tell: Render long paragraphs and code blocks; confirm styling remains readable with proper contrast and wrapping.

optional.aliases: tool selection handling / tool selection guidance
optional.day1_tell: Request a task requiring a specific tool; confirm tool selection guidance chooses or asks for the correct tool.
Send text longer than the truncation limit; confirm it is truncated safely with an indicator and no broken encoding.

optional.aliases: dependency security patching / security dependency update
optional.day1_tell: Run dependency audit; confirm patched versions are installed and the targeted vulnerability is gone.
Pass a payload through middleware; confirm original object remains unchanged after processing.
Enter credentials with casing, whitespace, or prefix variations; confirm normalized stored credentials authenticate.

optional.aliases: status badge visibility / status visibility fix
optional.day1_tell: Open the status badge area in all states/themes; confirm the badge is visible and readable.
Reference each new translation key in the UI; confirm no raw key names are displayed.
Click every documentation link; confirm it opens the intended current documentation page.
Configure a custom API endpoint; confirm requests go to that endpoint and not the default.

optional.aliases: oauth service extraction / oauth service integration
optional.day1_tell: Complete OAuth login/refresh/logout flow; confirm tokens are stored, refreshed, and revoked correctly.
Follow deployment docs on a clean environment; confirm the documented steps produce a running service.

optional.aliases: model initialization handling / model initialization refactor
optional.day1_tell: Initialize a model with valid, invalid, and missing config; confirm readiness or clear initialization errors.
Use inline mode from the supported client; confirm inline query, result selection, and response work.

optional.aliases: streaming output support / streaming tool support
optional.day1_tell: Invoke a streaming tool; confirm partial output streams and final result are handled correctly.

optional.aliases: model option filtering / model filtering support
optional.day1_tell: List models with capability/option filters; confirm only matching models are shown.
Run untrusted code attempting file/network escape; confirm the sandbox blocks it.
Generate an image; confirm the resulting image displays with correct dimensions and fallback text.
Check command availability for enabled, disabled, and unauthorized contexts; confirm visibility matches rules.
Edit a sent message; confirm stored content, display, and downstream state update.
Delete one message in a paired request/response; confirm the paired message is deleted or retained per spec.
Set model parameters like temperature/max tokens; confirm they are included in provider requests.

optional.aliases: history deletion logic / history cleanup logic
optional.day1_tell: Delete selected history entries; confirm cleanup removes dependent records without deleting unrelated history.
Run two users concurrently changing state; confirm each sees only their own state.
Open, close, and reload the panel; confirm panel state restores correctly.
Change language setting and restart; confirm the selected language remains active.
Run the code path with tuples of expected and unexpected lengths; confirm unpacking handles them safely.
Display corrected translations and auto-detected language text; confirm wording and detection are accurate.

optional.aliases: localized prompt fix / localized prompt refresh
optional.day1_tell: Switch locale after loading prompts; confirm localized prompts refresh to the new language.

optional.aliases: null configuration check / null configuration handling
optional.day1_tell: Start with null configuration sections; confirm null checks apply defaults or produce clear errors.

optional.aliases: text length handling / long text handling
optional.day1_tell: Submit very long text near and beyond limits; confirm length handling prevents crashes and informs the user.
Submit an image for recognition; confirm detected content is returned and errors are handled.
Install only the core module, then optional modules; confirm modular dependencies load only when needed.
Upload a compressed image; confirm it is decompressed or processed for recognition correctly.
Set different prompts in two conversations; confirm prompt changes do not leak between them.
Run concurrent writes to the same resource; confirm locking prevents race corruption.

optional.aliases: model selection fix / model selection update
optional.day1_tell: Select a different model and send a request; confirm the selected model is used immediately.
Send a request containing unsupported/null/internal fields; confirm payload filtering removes them.
Mock a model response with expected and edge-case content; confirm parsing produces the correct final message.

optional.aliases: prompt rendering fix / prompt rendering simplification
optional.day1_tell: Render prompts containing variables, markdown, and missing values; confirm output is simple and correct.

optional.aliases: event stream abstraction / event stream handling
optional.day1_tell: Consume event streams from multiple providers; confirm abstraction normalizes start, delta, error, and done events.
Use default paths on a fresh install; confirm corrected paths exist and are writable.
Resolve ambiguous and missing references; confirm resolver picks the correct target or reports ambiguity.
Attempt the affected action with allowed and denied permissions; confirm enforcement is correct.

optional.aliases: adapter initialization guard / adapter initialization validation
optional.day1_tell: Initialize an adapter with missing/invalid prerequisites; confirm guard prevents use and reports the issue.
Run the installer script on a clean machine/container; confirm it installs required files and is repeatable.

optional.aliases: editor bug fix / editor entry fix
optional.day1_tell: Open the editor entry point and perform a basic edit/save; confirm the editor works without errors.

optional.aliases: path conversion fix / path conversion logic
optional.day1_tell: Convert paths between URL, POSIX, and Windows forms; confirm resulting paths are valid.
Trigger an error with feedback enabled and disabled; confirm feedback is shown or suppressed as configured.
Reload a plugin after code/config change; confirm old instance is disposed and new behavior is active.
Navigate history with filters/search; confirm only matching entries appear in correct order.
